Subject: Pilot support request — Computational Civics class (Summer term)

Hi Jasmine,

I’m Simon Blake, faculty lead for the Computational Civics lab at Community University. We’re running a small pilot this summer integrating language model–assisted writing and civic data analysis into an undergraduate seminar (approx. 45 students). Budget constraints mean we can’t buy significant production credits.

Would Redwood consider a credit allocation or trial extension so we can run weekly in-class prompts and a final project that uses embeddings + generation? Ideally a six-month window and ~150k token-equivalent credits would cover the cohort. We’ve used free trials before but that ran out midterm last semester.

I’ve attached a short syllabus and our IRB confirmation. We’re an academic non-profit; anything you can offer (credits, extended trial, educator promo) would help and we’ll acknowledge Redwood in classroom materials.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Simon
Dr. Simon Blake

- Do you have an expected monthly token/run rate (ballpark) or peak concurrency during class demos?
- Will student accounts be individual or do you plan to funnel traffic through a central project account?
- Any specific privacy/compliance needs beyond the IRB (e.g., local data residency)?

Jasmine — quick read on this. 45 students with weekly in-class demos + final projects suggests spiky usage: estimate ~20k tokens/month for baseline instructional activities, with short peaks during grading/project submissions (~50k). The ask for 150k over six months is reasonable as a one-time EDU top-up (effectively ~25k/month).

Attached is a draft promo package that pairs the credits with a sandboxed instructor seat and a brief onboarding session from Solutions. If we add a short usage cap per student and require the instructor account as gateway we can limit misuse and keep costs predictable.

I recommend:
- Approve 150k token-equivalent credits, valid for 6 months
- Instructor-managed central project account + per-student API keys disabled
- EDU onboarding + one troubleshooting office hour from Solutions

If you want, I can prepare the HubSpot deal and a short addendum to the EDU promo terms.

Ben Carter
Education Programs
Redwood Inference
